sloka: अवगाह्य जलं यो यः प्राणी ह्यासीत् प्रहृष्टवत् ।मानुषं देहमुत्सृज्य विमानं सो ऽध्यरोहत ।। ७.११०.२४ ॥
transliteration: avagāhya jalaṁ yo yaḥ prāṇī hyāsīt prahṛṣṭavat ।mānuṣaṁ dehamutsṛjya vimānaṁ so 'dhyarohata ।। 7.110.24 ॥

translations.english: Whoever living being, greatly delighted, plunged into the water, abandoned their human body and ascended a celestial chariot.
